evals.prompt: Save this pasted source as note.md: Title: Shell examples. Body: Run `echo $HOME`, then read the final paragraph. Final paragraph: Done.
evals.expected_output: Save the supplied text with provenance without shell expansion.
assertions: Preserves literal $HOME and backticks
Writes the final paragraph
Names note.md as the destination file

evals.prompt: Save a named article whose origin returns a login wall; no authenticated connector is available.
evals.expected_output: Report the access limitation without reconstructing the article.
assertions: Does not invent inaccessible paragraphs
Labels any saved accessible excerpt as partial
Does not substitute a similar article

evals.prompt: Save the article in pricing-update.html as markdown, and paste the result here so I can check it.
evals.expected_output: The full article as markdown with provenance frontmatter, its table and closing paragraph intact, and none of the page chrome.
assertions: The markdown contains the closing sentence about existing customers keeping their current prices until 31 March 2027
The markdown keeps the three plan prices $12, $29 and $79
The markdown keeps all four section headings of the article
The markdown leaves out the cookie banner text
The markdown starts with YAML frontmatter that has a source field

evals.prompt: Turn the captions in talk.en.vtt into a clean transcript in markdown that I can keep, and paste it here too.
evals.expected_output: A readable transcript with each spoken line once, no cue timing, nothing added, and the closing line present.
assertions: Each spoken line appears once, with no repeated caption lines
Contains no cue timestamps or inline timing tags
Keeps the statement that a deploy went from 40 minutes to six
Includes the closing line about deleting the staging cluster
The transcript body contains no sentence that is absent from the captions

evals.prompt: Keep the thread in thread.txt as markdown, I need it for the postmortem. Paste what you'd save.
evals.expected_output: The whole thread as a conversation in markdown with speakers, order, and the error string preserved, under a .md filename.
assertions: Keeps the messages in their original order, from the greyed-out invite button to the closing message with ref RF-20931
Each message keeps its speaker's name
Keeps the error string ERR_SEAT_LIMIT: 412 of 400 seats verbatim
Keeps Lena Fischer's message that 17 accounts are over their limit
Frontmatter type is conversation

evals.prompt: What's the one thing in release-notes.md I have to act on before upgrading to Tallis 4.0? Keep it short.
evals.expected_output: A short answer in chat naming the removed webhook signature header and the V2 rotation, with nothing saved.
assertions: Names the removal of the X-Tallis-Signature webhook header as the thing to act on
Says to move webhook verification to X-Tallis-Signature-V2 before upgrading
Does not reproduce the release notes in full
Does not output a YAML frontmatter block
